suggestions: pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
convert an IN subquery to a semi-join
reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
optimized_sql:
WITH female_wide_customers AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd_education_status = 'College'
),
year_2001_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
non_direct_promos AS (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N'
)
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       avg(ss.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
       avg(ss.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
       avg(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
       avg(ss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM year_2001_dates yd
JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = yd.d_date_sk
JOIN female_wide_customers fc ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = fc.cd_demo_sk
JOIN non_direct_promos np ON ss.ss_promo_sk = np.p_promo_sk
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id
ORDER BY i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
